previous_catalog_record.summary: 0-bg grid (h, w~9-14) with 1-3 SEPARATED SOLID color-3 (green) RECTANGLES, each 3-5 cells wide and 3-5 cells tall, each MISSING EXACTLY ONE INTERIOR CELL (a single 0-cell at a non-border position within the rectangle's bounding box). Rectangles do not touch each other and are separated by background. Rule: for every green rectangle, IDENTIFY its missing interior cell (the unique 0 strictly inside its bbox). FILL that cell with color 8 (cyan), leaving the green rectangle otherwise untouched. Net: each green rectangle gets its missing interior pixel patched in cyan.

scope: Accepted generator repair; finite reviewer evidence, no new maintainer execution

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The selected set of rectangle-hole coordinates.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Identify every four-connected green rectangle, derive its bounding box and missing zero cell, then select either all rectangles or only the unique largest rectangle according to the episode-fixed fill_scope.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Copy the input and paint exactly the selected hole coordinates cyan (8), leaving every green cell and unrelated distractor unchanged.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step B receives no independent rectangle choice: its paint coordinates are exactly Step A’s selected holes. Replacing the all-rectangle selection with the largest-only selection on the same input leaves some holes unpainted and changes the final grid.
